commitResults.messageTitle: Add task tracking and list printing
Fix gitignore for Codex, Add Mark Functionality

commitResults.messageBody:
Aigis uses task objects but the Java sources are in the default package and mix formatting, naming, and resource-handling conventions.

Move Aigis and Task into the aigis package. Rename the task collection and completion setter, centralize display constants, document public APIs, guard against a full task list, and update the launch path in the README.

The refactor aligns the application with the project Java standard and keeps task state changes and command output consistent.

Java changes need a project-local standard so future edits use consistent conventions.

Add the SE-EDU-based Java skill and make its files trackable in the repository.

The shared guidance gives future agents a repeatable review checklist for package structure, naming, formatting, and public API documentation.

Commit and branch naming need project-local guidance so repository history stays consistent.

Add the SE-EDU-based Git skill covering imperative subjects, line limits, WHAT/WHY bodies, and kebab-case branch names.

The shared checklist helps future agents prepare reviewable commits without authorizing commits or pushes by itself.

Future Java and Git work needs explicit project guidance so agents apply the same conventions.

Require the project Java and Git skills for source changes, commits, and branch names while preserving the explicit permission requirement for committing and pushing.

Centralizing these requirements in AGENTS.md makes them apply consistently across repository tasks.

Claude-based repository work needs the same project guidance as other agents.\n\nReference the Java and Git standard skills from CLAUDE.md so coding, commit, and branch conventions remain consistent across agent entry points.
